summary.tldr: Requires the transport minister to create and report on a national strategy for abandoned vessels.
what_it_does: Adds a definition of “Indigenous governing body” for the act.
Requires the Minister of Transport to develop and implement a national strategy to address abandoned vessels.

Requires the strategy to include ways to identify vessel owners, review disposal fees, create turn-in and disposal areas, support recycling standards, plan for mooring, and improve disposal processes.

Requires the strategy to assess whether enough resources are in place, including for the Canadian Coast Guard, and to allow cooperation with provincial governments and Indigenous governing bodies where appropriate.
Requires a report on the strategy and its implementation schedule within one year, then annual progress reports, with tabling in Parliament and publication on the Transport Department website.
summary.background: The bill amends the Wrecked, Abandoned or Hazardous Vessels Act.
